title: docs(skills): teach the derived-measure fixed-currency refusal beside the two fixed-currency refusals
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCYhrp146Mk9BxnoRcGGQcD)_

Fixes #28051

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Cross-lane dispatch: `domain:skills` card dispatched and reviewed by `domain:server#2` under the maintainer's 「座位之间可以协调，你有空你就可以派」 (claim 6545242148); the two devx pages ride as the sibling PR #28015 (#27994) carried them.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：两份 skills 和两页文档补上第三条 `fixed` 币种拒收：派生 `sum` / `difference` 的操作数全部落在同一个 `fixed` 币种时，度量自己声明另一个 `currency` 会在数据集编译时被拒（`DATASET_INVALID` / 400）。改法照运行时的原话：删掉度量的 `currency`（列取操作数的币种），或写同一币种。两页文档同时写明：这样的派生列在线上答复里也带那个币种（PR #28122 落地的行为，本任在 `main` 上实测）。
- **为什么改**：PR #28043 加了这条拒收，四处文字只教前两条；AI 按旧文给 EUR 固定币种的派生求和写上 `currency: 'USD'`，数据集会被拒而文档没说。
- **风险与回滚**：只改文字，无 schema、键或行为变化。两份 skills 的 token 天花板不动：每处新增都在同文件内删重复付账（`field-types.md` 删掉示例已给出的 `currency_code` 命名惯例；`dashboards.md` 删掉已退役的 `categoryGranularity` 括注，解析拒收与 Dataset-Bound Widgets 段已有它）。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**：`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` 的数据集币种注释（L300-306），`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` 的 Currency resolution 段（L174-177）。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 预期全绿（`field-types.md` 3207/3207，`dashboards.md` 6259/6262）；对照 `packages/services/service-analytics/src/measure-currency-coherence.ts` Guard 1 末尾的 `resolved?.fixed` 分支读四处文字。
- **需要你做的**：`skills/**` 是 Tier H 受管面：PR 留 draft，等你批准；契约复审由席位在本 head 上做。

## What changes

The shipped refusal, read from `measure-currency-coherence.ts` Guard 1 on `main` (and pinned in `record-currency-analytics.test.ts`): a derived measure that declares a `currency` over measures whose amounts are fixed to one code, with a different code, is refused `DATASET_INVALID` / 400; the message ends `delete the measure's \`currency\` (the column takes the operands' CODE), or restate CODE.` Each of the four texts now teaches that case and that prescription in its own words, beside the two `fixed` refusals PR #28015 taught:

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (Currency resolution): "over a `'fixed'` one, or a derived sum/difference over one `'fixed'` code, it may only restate that code, else `DATASET_INVALID`: delete it, and the column takes the code". Reader: the agent writing a `currency` field and then a dataset measure over it; the mistake prevented is `currency: 'USD'` on a derived sum of EUR-fixed measures. Paid for by deleting "(by convention `currency_code`)", which the example two lines above already shows (`currencyField: 'currency_code'`).
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (the dataset currency comment): "A `fixed` field, or a derived sum/difference over one `fixed` code, refuses another `currency` (delete it, the column takes that code; restating is fine)". Reader: the agent writing a dataset measure for a dashboard; the same mistake. Paid for by deleting "(The old widget-level `categoryGranularity` was removed in the single-form cutover.)": the parse refusal names that key with its prescription (`LEGACY_WIDGET_ANALYTICS_KEYS` in `dashboard.zod.ts`) and the Dataset-Bound Widgets paragraph already says the closed schema rejects the legacy keys by name, so the sentence had two homes.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` (Roll-ups and datasets): a new bullet for the derived case with the prescription, and the existing sentence "a derived `sum` or `difference` over one `fixed` code carries that code" now says "on its result column too": true on the wire since PR #28122 (#28049), measured below.
- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` (the currency chain): the chain paragraph gains the derived step (a derived `sum` / `difference` whose operands all resolve to one `fixed` code takes that code at the field's step; any other derived measure is monetary only by its own `currency`, else its column carries none), and the refusal paragraph gains the derived case with the prescription.
- `.changeset/28051-skills-derived-currency-refusal.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch. The order ruled `skip-changeset`; os-dev.md's published-surface criterion wins over the order on a conflict, and it is measured: `packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copies `skills/**` into that package's `dist/`, which is in its `files[]`, and the sibling PR #28015 carried the same patch changeset. Recorded in the report's `open_questions`.

## Tests

No code changes. The wire behaviour the docs now teach was measured on `origin/main` `5da3a8ce` in this worktree, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/service-analytics^...' build` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0):

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose src/__tests__/record-currency-analytics.test.ts
 ✓ … > a derived measure column takes the currency its operands resolve to > native strategy: a sum or difference over one fixed code carries it; no other derived column gains one
 ✓ … > objectql strategy: a sum or difference over one fixed code carries it; no other derived column gains one
 ✓ … > the draft-preview path labels the same columns
 ✓ … > compile-time guards on measure currencies > a derived sum declaring a currency other than its operands' one fixed code is refused, naming the fix
 ✓ … > a derived difference declaring a currency other than its operands' one fixed code is refused, naming the fix
 ✓ … > CONTROL: a derived measure restating its operands' one fixed code is accepted
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  60 passed (60)
```

The refusal pin asserts the message tail `delete the measure's \`currency\` (the column takes the operands' EUR), or restate EUR.`; the wire pin asserts `fields[].currency === 'EUR'` on `eur_twice` (sum) and `eur_net` (difference) with no `currencyField`, and `currency` undefined on every derived column whose operands resolve to no one `fixed` code (`usd_and_tenant`, `tenant_twice`, `jpy_twice`, `eur_per_invoice`, `eur_product`, `total_twice`).

## Acceptance notes

- The card's Wanted quoted the message as it stood in PR #28043 ("or delete it, in which case the column carries no currency code"). PR #28122 (#28049) changed both the wire and that sentence before this card was dispatched; the order says to teach what landed, so the texts teach "the column takes the operands' code".
- `content/docs/**` is not a governed surface, but it rides this Tier H PR, so the whole PR waits for the maintainer's approval.
- No out-of-scope findings.

## Verification

Head `02980b19`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final diff (5 files): 67 derived families, every one run locally with its exit code captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1 < /dev/null; EXIT=$?`). `--ran`: "67 derived, 66 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 (needs every package's `dist`; 68 packages unbuilt here). CI runs it.

Exit 3 (its GOVERNED verdict).
